q2_gaps: A container/content of-phrase ('pouches OF salt-bloom'): the genitive rule explicitly excludes measure of-phrases ('a cup of water') and supplies no replacement, so the parse's entity-attached (Of sk_pouch_1 salt_bloom) is improvised.
'immediately' (S2) is an immediacy/temporal adverb with no licensed slot - the instruction set's own 'leave it out and record the gap' case; the parse correctly drops it and the content is lost.

A wholly-negated finite complement ('told ... that the Northcove needed NO salt-bloom'): no polarity carrier exists inside a seal, so the instruction set prescribes dropping the complement entirely - the parse follows that registered limitation and the whole message content is lost.
A day-index within a year ('on DAY 17 of Year 1'): the (Day <n>) term is the calendar day-of-month slot; a 'day N of Year Y' calendar has no defined encoding.
A passage-initial date frame ('On day 17 of Year 1, ...'): nothing states whether it scopes over the following sentences, so only the first clause ends up dated.
notes: 'the Council' as a capitalized-common-noun collective (no Name, no GroupOf, no distribution), the decide-to-begin control complement (top-level, tenseless, subject control), and the Experiencer/Recipient split on 'told' all match the instruction set.
